caption: The image displays a round decorative plate featuring a complex border with geometric patterns consisting of interlocking hexagonal shapes, lines, and chevrons. The plate has a scalloped rim. The central part of the plate contains an illustration with several human figures; three standing and one seated. The standing figures are dressed in period attire, with hats and coats, and are facing each other in a group, while the fourth figure is seated on the ground and appears to be interacting with the others. The background of the illustration includes details such as palm trees, tropical plants, a thatched structure, and distant mountains, indicating an outdoor setting. The plate appears to be monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray, which suggests that the image is a black and white photograph of the object.
title: Plate - "Penn's Treaty with the Indians"
